name: retrieve_protein_expression
description: Use this tool to retrieve protein tissue expression information for a specific gene name. This tool is appropriate when you need detailed expression data related to a gene. Do not use this tool if you are looking for general information about genes or if you need data on multiple genes at once; consider using a batch query tool instead.

parameters.name: gene_name
parameters.description: The name of the gene for which protein tissue expression information is requested. Must be a valid gene symbol recognized in biological databases.

gene_name.description: The gene name that was queried.

expression_data.description: An array of objects containing tissue expression information.

tissue.description: The name of the tissue where the expression was measured.

expression_level.description: The level of expression of the protein in the specified tissue, typically on a scale from 0 to 100.

return_schema.description: Returns protein tissue expression data for the specified gene.
